name: HUBLINE
recent: Hubline 确认其子公司运营的一架直升机在砂拉越 Long Lellang 坠毁，造成五人死亡。公司董事及大股东在 2026 年 11 月初出现股份权益变动，包括一笔 3300 万股场外减持。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收环比增长 20%，但净利仍为亏损。
notable: 公司确认其子公司运营的直升机在砂拉越 Long Lellang 坠毁，机上五人全部罹难。
公司发布 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收环比增长 20%，净利仍为亏损。
risks: 子公司涉及的致命直升机坠毁事件可能带来法律责任及声誉影响。
集团执行总裁间接持股的 BNDM Incorporated Holdings 在场外减持 3300 万股（约 0.769%）。
最新季度净利仍为亏损（净亏损 29.9 万令吉）。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 4616.4 万令吉，环比增长 20.0%，同比增长 5.3%；净亏损 29.9 万令吉，净利率 -0.6%，较上一季度的 -7.4% 有所收窄。

recent_en: Hubline confirmed that a helicopter operated by its subsidiary crashed in Long Lellang, Sarawak, killing five people. There were changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests in early November 2026, including an off-market disposal of 33 million shares. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 20% QoQ but the company remained in net loss.
notable_en: The company confirmed that a helicopter operated by its subsidiary crashed in Long Lellang, Sarawak, killing all five people on board.
BNDM Incorporated Holdings, indirectly held by Group Executive President Dato Sri Richard Wee, disposed of 33 million shares off market.
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue up 20% QoQ but still in net loss.
risks_en: The fatal helicopter crash involving a subsidiary may lead to legal liability and reputational impact.
BNDM Incorporated Holdings, indirectly held by the Group Executive President, disposed of 33 million shares (about 0.769%) off market.
The latest quarter remained in net loss (net loss of MYR 299,000).
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 46.164 million, up 20.0% QoQ and 5.3% YoY; net loss was MYR 299,000 with a net margin of -0.6%, narrower than -7.4% in the previous quarter.
